navy.source: sampled from assets/oclc-logo.png: median of the three navy squares (wordmark measures #0E2048)
navy.use: primary; all body and headline text on cream; outlines

teal.source: sampled from assets/oclc-logo.png: median of the 'L' square
teal.use: primary accent; never for text on cream (2.13:1)

gold.use: small highlights only: stars, ticks, underlines

terracotta.use: cheeks and small warm details only

contrast.rule: text must be >= 4.5:1; navy on cream passes, teal on cream does not and is used for shapes only

jawi.rendering: always set as live text in the browser (dir=rtl, lang=ms-Arab) so letters join; never as individual glyph shapes

fonts.malay_support: Bahasa Melayu (Rumi) uses basic Latin only; Montserrat latin subset covers it

rules: use the file as is; never redraw, recolour, crop into, stretch or add effects
place on cream; keep clear space of at least one logo square on every side

style.name: layered cardstock paper-cut
style.base_library_style: Lemo-Opuscar papercut-red (materials and motion only; palette replaced by this file)
rules: flat cut-paper pieces, subtle grain, slightly irregular hand-cut edges
2-3 depth layers with soft drop shadows; light from top-left
no gradients, no gloss, no 3D shading
characters step at about 12 fps inside a 30 fps film (pose sampled at floor(t*12)/12, holds of 2-3 frames); camera, light and text move every frame

illustration_palette._note: supporting paper tones for characters and props; brand colours above stay the heroes
